name: Otawara
description: Otawara is the floating Soratami (moonfolk) city on Kamigawa, resting on clouds above Lake Kamitaki and later home to the Saiba Futurists.

bio.text: In Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty, Kaito tailed Tameshi on Otawara, met Tamiyo there, and stole the Reality Chip from Tameshi's lab before the three planeswalkers fled the city.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu unleashes his oni army on Otawara, and Toshi declares war on him.
timeline.quote: Toshi openly declared a war between the two founding members of the hyozan

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi defeats Chiyo and releases the oni-dog, which destroys much of Otawara.
timeline.quote: He fought and defeated Chiyo, then released Hidetsugu's oni-dog from the tile to destroy much of Otawara.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: For weeks Kaito tails Tameshi on Otawara and finds he is hiding secret deals and a secret project.
timeline.quote: And he'd watched the unregulated drones leave the compound and head straight for the Towashi Undercity.

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito disables a security camera and breaks into Tameshi's compound while Tameshi is away.
timeline.quote: No camera would see him now

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: In Tameshi's office Kaito finds a coded message to meet in the Undercity that night and a blueprint of a strange device.
timeline.quote: The meeting was happening tonight, and soon

citation.work: Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames
citation.text: "Episode 2: Lies, Promises, and Neon Flames" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito follows the nezumi's rabbit drone to Otawara.
timeline.quote: The tanuki followed, and Kaito headed in the direction of Otawara.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito fights a moonfolk with scrolls, who paralyzes him with a scroll spell.
timeline.quote: The moment she read the words, Kaito felt his entire body stiffen.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Learning that Kaito knows of Tezzeret, the moonfolk releases the spell and introduces herself as Tamiyo.
timeline.quote: "I am Tamiyo," she said, voice as unwavering as steel.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito realizes Tamiyo is a planeswalker, and meets her son Nashi.
timeline.quote: "You're a planeswalker."

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells Kaito that Tezzeret is the man with the metal arm and that he burned the nezumi village.
timeline.quote: Kaito learned that Tezzeret wasn't just a planeswalker—he was the planeswalker with the metal arm.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reveals the Reality Chip and that the Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same.
timeline.quote: "The Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same."

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito resolves to steal the chip immediately rather than wait as Tamiyo urges.
timeline.quote: And he wasn't about to wait for Tamiyo's permission.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito uses Tameshi's key card to enter the lab and finds kami being drained of their essence.
timeline.quote: There were dozens of them—alive, but shriveled and dull, as if their very essence was being sucked out of them.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito steals the Reality Chip from its stand.
timeline.quote: So Kaito reached out, grabbed the Reality Chip from its stand, and shoved it in his pocket.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito encounters the monster who murdered Tameshi, who names himself Jin-Gitaxias and calls ninjas.
timeline.quote: The existence of a second Jin-Gitaxias on this plane is highly improbable

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito fights the Undercity ninjas and escapes the lab with a smoke bomb.
timeline.quote: Black smoke exploded through the crowd

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Cornered by a dragon-shaped mech, Kaito chooses not to planeswalk with the chip.
timeline.quote: Leaving right now was too great a risk.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Reality Chip stirs, and a swordswoman cuts down the mech: the emperor, who is the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo hides the henchmen with an invisibility spell, and the three planeswalkers flee Otawara.
timeline.quote: the three planeswalkers fled from Otawara in silence.

citation.text: "Episode 3: An Unexpected Alliance" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer, Kaito and Tamiyo defeat the henchmen in the compound and hold Tezzeret paralyzed; the Wanderer decides to bring him to Kyodai.
timeline.quote: "Yes. We will decide his fate together."

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret takes control of the Reality Chip on the Wanderer's hand, destabilizing her spark and linking her to Kyodai in agony.
timeline.quote: no time to shout a warning before Tezzeret took control of the Reality Chip.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito knocks Tezzeret out with two crates.
timeline.quote: The impact knocked Tezzeret out cold.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo removes the chip from the Wanderer's hand and then places it on her own hand to pilot a surveillance mech to Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo lifted the Reality Chip to the back of her own hand and pressed the panel to her flesh.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer disables a surveillance mech and the group flies to Eiganjo on its back, carrying Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The mech let out a ragged groan before lowering its body to the ground

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Katsumasa shows Kotori the Epoch Engine, a prototype mech, and asks her to pilot it in secret.
timeline.quote: I call this prime iteration the Epoch Engine—and I want you to be its pilot.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Kotori syncs with the mech and feels a flicker of something beneath, then hears the name Shorikai.
timeline.quote: Shorikai.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Katsumasa brushes aside Kotori's question about the new technology and orders her into daily training.
timeline.quote: I expect you to be combat ready by the end of the month, understand?"

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Kotori meets her friend Arima in a coffee house; Arima warns that people say Katsumasa's research is unnatural.
timeline.quote: They say his research is unnatural."

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: While training at night, Kotori bonds with Shorikai and glimpses a vision of herself killing Katsumasa.
timeline.quote: Sliding the blade soundlessly into his jugular.

citation.text: "The Epoch Engine". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Feb 2022.

timeline.summary: Otawara moves over Kamigawa with a purpose few understand.
timeline.quote: the soaring city of Otawara moves over Kamigawa with a purpose that few understand.

citation.text: Skycloud Expanse (Neon Dynasty Commander, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Now, Kaito sneaks through Otawara past the Soratami drones to steal an iron scroll.
timeline.quote: Pressing himself flat against an alley wall, Kaito Shizuki watched a drone soar by

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito knocks out a guard at the changing of the guard and picks the lock of the treasure room.
timeline.quote: Kaito moved behind the guard and hit him on the back of the head with the pommel of his sword.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds the scroll protected by a spider kami's spirit web and asks Himoto to unweave it.
timeline.quote: A spider kami hung above the scroll in a delicate spirit web

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The white-haired Wanderer appears behind Kaito and blocks his blade with her own.
timeline.quote: The white-haired woman standing behind him offered a slight smile, her sword still lifted to prevent him from completing a stroke.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Kaito she needs his help because Nashi is in trouble.
timeline.quote: I came because I need your help. Nashi's in trouble.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 1: Don't Go Past the Old Dark House " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Toshi appears at Otawara palace; Chiyo fights and is defeated, and an oni-dog ruins her face.
timeline.quote: her face was ruined forever - she lost an eye and her nose was broken

citation.text: "Chiyo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Jukai, Imperials and Minamo collaborate to develop merge gates around every rift.
timeline.quote: the mortals built gates around every new rift

citation.text: "Merge gate", section "The Era of Enlightenment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the war Minamo is rebuilt, but later declines and is replaced by Otawara.
timeline.quote: After the war, the Minamo School was rebuilt

citation.text: "Minamo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Kamigawa's Modern Age the moonfolk open Otawara to outsiders and it becomes a center of innovation.
timeline.quote: opening Otawara to outsiders (though still not Oboro palace itself), and allowing the city to become a center of innovation

citation.text: "Moonfolk", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The moonfolk establish the Saiba Futurists and ask the dragon kami Kairi to protect Otawara, but Kairi refuses.
timeline.quote: the moonfolk asked the dragon kami Kairi to protect their city, only for the great kami to refuse

citation.text: "Moonfolk", section "Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Kami War, Toshiro Umezawa secretly follows Chiyo to Otawara and reveals himself; she attacks him in rage.
timeline.quote: Toshiro Umezawa secretly followed the soratami prophet Chiyo to the streets of Otawara

citation.text: "Otawara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshiro cracks Chiyo's nose, summons Hidetsugu's oni hound to Otawara, and escapes through the Shadow Gate.
timeline.quote: Toshi cracked her nose

citation.text: "Otawara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.quote: The city was badly damaged during the New Phyrexian Invasion
